scenes.line1: Why split data into bronze, silver, gold?
scenes.say: Ever wonder why data pipelines use bronze, silver, and gold layers? What’s the point of splitting data like that?
Bronze holds raw logs straight from the source. Silver cleans and joins that data into usable tables. Gold is where you find business-level, analytics-ready info.

scenes.label: Quality
scenes.sub: Each layer isolates issues and improves reliability
scenes.say: Each layer isolates data quality issues. That means you can fix problems early and make analytics more reliable.
Picture raw JSON logs at the start. By the end, you’ve got sales totals by region, ready for business use.

scenes.question: Is gold data always raw and unprocessed?
scenes.right: No, gold is cleaned, aggregated, and ready for analytics.
scenes.say: Don’t mix up the layers! Gold isn’t raw—it’s the most refined, business-ready data.
